rationale: FilesPage retains one client collection and selection/modal composition. DELETE transaction/readback now delegates to cohesive deletion owner and dialog; no additional domain, shared owner or native contract. The remaining 245-line body is existing collection toolbar/folder/table/modal JSX with scope-keyed deletion child. New deletion modules do not exceed mandatory size thresholds. Root owns registry review. DeleteFile is one confirmation dialog with pending/unknown/current-state branches and delegates all request/scope semantics to its hook; the native-status presentation is intentionally kept with this one decision. Do not split JSX only to fall below a size threshold.
